summary: A two-item docs nav (Guides, Reference) that opens on hover at once and stays open 400 ms after the pointer leaves.
use: Tuning how eager the hover behaviour is for dense navigation, and aligning each panel to its button's start or end.
spec: `<NavigationMenuItem label="Guides" align="start">` and `<NavigationMenuItem label="Reference" align="end">` align their panels to the button
